meta.title: Siaya County fiscal series from county documents and the Auditor-General, FY 2013/14 to FY 2024/25
meta.rule: Separate series, never blended with each other or with the Controller of Budget series in data/history.json: county-cbrop (the County Treasury's Budget Review and Outlook Papers), oag-ror-table (the twelve-year own-source revenue table the County Treasury reports in the Auditor-General's Receiver of Revenue reports, Other Information outside the audit opinion), oag-ror (the audited Receiver of Revenue statements and the auditor's text) and oag-crf (the audited County Revenue Fund statements). Every value keeps its basis. comparisons put the series side by side for each year; they choose nothing. Gaps are listed, never filled.

bases.cash: Receipts actually received in the year (statement of receipts and disbursements, statement of cash flows).
bases.accrual: Revenue earned in the year, including amounts billed but not yet received (statement of financial performance). The Receiver of Revenue moved to accrual reporting in FY 2024/25.
bases.treasury_table: Figures the County Treasury reports in the management discussion of an audit report; the audit opinion does not cover them.
bases.county_review: The County Treasury's own review of the year (CBROP); not audited.

meta.ocr_rule: Scanned Auditor-General pages were read by three tesseract passes (300 dpi psm 6, 400 dpi psm 4, 150 dpi psm 3). A figure is stored at confidence 3 only when at least two passes show it; otherwise confidence is capped at 2 and needs_human_check is true. Arithmetic checks (variance, quarters, note totals) are recorded in arithmetic_checks.
meta.confidence_scale: 5 = clean printed table read twice; 4 = clean table or exact printed figure; 3 = OCR of a scanned page read twice; 2 = chart label, garbled text or a figure read only once; 1 = not used
meta.review: Provisional: awaiting editorial review. Nothing is approved.

gaps.reason: CBROP of September 2023 not found (KIPPRA's "2023" record is the September 2024 paper).
CBROP 2025 (GOV-03) values are in data/siaya-fiscal-ledger.json; not repeated here.
Own-source revenue totals not transcribed: the papers give them only in narrative or stream tables without a clean total row.
Receiver of Revenue statements before FY 2021/22 not found; FY 2021/22 and FY 2022/23 reports are in the Parliament library (link only, not downloaded).
Only the FY 2024/25 County Revenue Fund report was downloaded; FY 2021/22 is in the Parliament library (link only).
